<DOCSTRING>
Manages a collection of users, adding new users and processing their status.

This class is responsible for maintaining a list of users and processing each user to determine if they are an adult or a minor based on their age. It is used by various services to manage user data and ensure that user statuses are correctly logged.

@attribute {Array<Object>} users - The list of users managed by this class. Each user is an object with at least a `name` and `isAdult` method.
</DOCSTRING>
